data.text:
# One flow: what happens between a person and a ledger row.
#
# `before` is the state each block is in when the flow starts, and the
# `components` map on a step is what that step changed. A step that changes
# nothing says nothing.

apiVersion: elderlygate/designer/design/v2
kind: Flow
metadata:
  id: drop-a-parcel
  title: Drop a parcel
spec:
  entry:
    method: POST
    path: /v1/parcels
  before:
    CMP-LOCKS:
      doors.open: 0
    CMP-LEDGER:
      rows: 0
  steps:
    - id: person
      at: CMP-KIOSK
      phase: caller
      label: Somebody scans a barcode
      note: The only actor. Everything after this is the locker answering one question — which door.
    - id: pick
      at: CMP-LOCKS
      phase: execute
      label: Choose a free door
      budgetMs: 50
      components:
        CMP-LOCKS:
          doors.open: 1
      findings:
        RSK-001: The step that picks one door is the step a fail-open would turn into all of them.
    - id: write
      at: CMP-LEDGER
      phase: execute
      label: Append the row
      budgetMs: 10
      components:
        CMP-LEDGER:
          rows: 1
      note: "Written before the door opens: a row with no parcel behind it is recoverable, a parcel with no row is not."
    - id: open
      at: CMP-LOCKS
      phase: return
      label: The door opens
